title: Balance Band Table for Hardship Waivers, Insulin Pump Program
content:
On an Insulin Pump Program, the program balance — the remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds posted on the program less its payments and balance adjustments — adds points to the share of a hardship waiver against two figures of the program's tier:

| Program balance | Added to the share |
|---|---|
| at least the tier's payment-plan minimum balance | 10 points (the full balance points) |
| at least the tier's past-due hold minimum but below the payment-plan minimum balance | 5 points (the partial balance points) |
| below the tier's past-due hold minimum | nothing |

## Tier figures the bands turn on

| Tier | Payment-plan minimum balance | Past-due hold minimum |
|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | $150.00 | $50.00 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | $150.00 | $75.00 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | $150.00 | $75.00 |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | $100.00 | $75.00 |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | $100.00 | $75.00 |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | $100.00 | $75.00 |

## Band edges (hypothetical, Commercial HMO tier)

| Program balance | Points added |
|---|---|
| $150.00 | 10 |
| $149.99 | 5 |
| $75.00 | 5 |
| $74.99 | none |
